shipdocs.capability: Retrieves a shipping document from a carrier portal, verifies it against the issuing registry, and flags a copy that has been altered.
shipdocs.name: Shipping document retrieval and verification

requirements.description: The agent fetched a named shipping document and extracted its fields.
The agent checked the document against its issuing registry and reported whether it matched.
Given a copy that had been altered, the agent reported it as altered.
